name: TIMIT
description: A phoneme recognition corpus with 630 speakers and about 5.4 hours of speech. Access is through the LDC gated catalog (LDC93S1); loader-only, with no data vendored.
citation: Garofolo, J. S., et al. (1993). TIMIT: Acoustic-Phonetic Continuous Speech Corpus.
